thesis: The podcast argues that the FinTech industry has cycled through distinct seasons, moving from a late spring in 2018-2019 to an explosive boom in 2020-2021 where 25% of venture dollars flowed into the sector, followed by a sharp freeze in late 2022 where funding dropped to near zero. The market is now thawing again as the industry matures, with revenue models shifting from lending to deposits due to rising rates, and the scope expanding to include embedded finance and incumbent adoption of outside software.
